title: Outboard Motor Cover – Durable Protection
descriptionHtml:
Protect the motor between trips

Sun, rain and dust wear on the outboard when it sits unused. An unprotected engine cowl quickly gets faded, dirty and exposed to moisture.

Durable fabric that seals tight

The motor cover is sewn from thick, water-resistant polyester fabric that protects against wind and weather. The elastic edge keeps the cover in place even in a breeze and makes it easy to take off and put on.

Features

  • Thick, water-resistant polyester fabric
  • Protects against sun, rain, dust and moisture
  • Elastic edge that stays put in wind
  • Fits motors in several sizes
  • Easy to take off and put on when in use

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
